title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15-Inch Solid Brass Retro Wave Collection Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your kitchen organization with a wall mount paper towel holder crafted from solid brass, designed to keep paper towels within reach while freeing up countertop space.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted installation helps reduce countertop clutter
- Crafted from solid brass for a substantial, enduring feel
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, refined look
- Coordinates with the Retro Wave collection for a matching Retro Wave setup
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement options

Specs:
- Collection: Retro Wave (Traditional/Classic)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 15-Inch H x 2.25-Inch W x 4-Inch L; 5-Inch projection
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Hardware: Includes installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
